# Analysis

## Check association between cancer types and TCR

```{r}
can_type = sample_info$cancer_type
length(unique(can_type))

get_pvals <- function(dat_mat, can_type){
  u_can_type = unique(can_type)

  pvals <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(dat_mat), .combine="rbind") %dopar% {
    yi = dat_mat[i,]
    gi0 = glm(yi ~ 1, family = "binomial")
    pv1 = rep(NA, length(u_can_type))
    
    for(j in 1:length(u_can_type)){
      u_can1 = as.numeric(can_type == u_can_type[j])
      gi1 = glm(yi ~ u_can1, family = "binomial")
      pv1[j] = anova(gi0, gi1, test="LRT")[["Pr(>Chi)"]][2]
    }
    pv1
  }
  
  pvals
}



date()
pval_TCRA = get_pvals(TCR_A_mat, can_type)
date()
pval_TCRB = get_pvals(TCR_B_mat, can_type)
date()
pval_mut  = get_pvals(mut_mat, can_type)
date()

rownames(pval_TCRA) = rownames(TCR_A_mat)
colnames(pval_TCRA) = unique(can_type)

rownames(pval_TCRB) = rownames(TCR_B_mat)
colnames(pval_TCRB) = unique(can_type)

rownames(pval_mut) = rownames(mut_mat)
colnames(pval_mut) = unique(can_type)

```

## Calculate the p-values given cancer types

```{r}
can_type = sample_info$cancer_type
length(unique(can_type))

TCR_rd  = log10(sample_info$abundance)

pval_adj <- function(res, TCR_mat, mut_mat, can_type, TCR_rd){
  u_can_type = unique(can_type)

  w_TCR = match(res$TCR, rownames(TCR_mat))
  w_mut = match(res$mut, rownames(mut_mat))

  stopifnot(sum(is.na(w_TCR))==0)
  stopifnot(sum(is.na(w_mut))==0)

  pvals <- foreach(i = 1:nrow(res), .combine="rbind") %dopar% {

    yi = TCR_mat[w_TCR[i],]
    xi = mut_mat[w_mut[i],]
    
    pv1 = rep(NA, length(u_can_type))
    
    for(j in 1:length(u_can_type)){
      u_can1 = as.numeric(can_type == u_can_type[j])
      l0 = glm(yi ~ TCR_rd + u_can1, family = "binomial")
      l1 = glm(yi ~ xi*TCR_rd + u_can1, family = "binomial")
      pv1[j] = anova(l0, l1, test="LRT")[["Pr(>Chi)"]][2]
    }
    pv1
  }
  
  pvals
}
```


```{r }
date()
p_adj_ct_TCRA = pval_adj(res_A, TCR_A_mat, mut_mat, can_type, TCR_rd)
date()
p_adj_ct_TCRB = pval_adj(res_B, TCR_B_mat, mut_mat, can_type, TCR_rd)
date()

colnames(p_adj_ct_TCRA) = unique(can_type)
colnames(p_adj_ct_TCRB) = unique(can_type)

res_A_ct = cbind(res_A, p_adj_ct_TCRA)
fwrite(res_A_ct, 
       file = file.path(result_dir, "TCR_alpha_mut_asso_rd_x_with_ct.tsv"))

res_B_ct = cbind(res_B, p_adj_ct_TCRB)
fwrite(res_B_ct, 
       file = file.path(result_dir, "TCR_beta_mut_asso_rd_x_with_ct.tsv"))

```


## Summarize p-values for TCR alpha

```{r fig.width = 4, fig.height = 3.2}

res_A_ct = fread(file.path(result_dir, "TCR_alpha_mut_asso_rd_x_with_ct.tsv"))
res_B_ct = fread(file.path(result_dir, "TCR_beta_mut_asso_rd_x_with_ct.tsv"))

dim(res_A_ct)
res_A_ct[1:2,]

dim(res_B_ct)
res_B_ct[1:2,]

w1 = which(names(res_A_ct) == "overlap_grp") + 1
p_adj_ct_TCRA = res_A_ct[,w1:ncol(res_A_ct)]
p_max_TCRA = apply(p_adj_ct_TCRA, 1, max)
res_A_ct$pval_LRT_max_ct = p_max_TCRA

summary(res_A_ct$pval_LRT/res_A_ct$pval_LRT_max_ct)
res_A_ct[pval_LRT/pval_LRT_max_ct < 0.01, 
      c("TCR", "mut", "pval_LRT", "pval_LRT_max_ct")]

ct_max_TCRA = apply(p_adj_ct_TCRA, 1, which.max)
tb1 = table(colnames(p_adj_ct_TCRA)[ct_max_TCRA])
sort(tb1, decreasing = TRUE)

ggplot(data = res_A_ct, mapping = aes(x = -log10(pval_LRT), 
                                   y = -log10(pval_LRT_max_ct))) +
  geom_pointdensity() +
  scale_color_viridis() + ggtitle("alpha chain") + 
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linewidth=1.5, color = "red") + 
  xlab(expression(-log[10]~"(p-value w/o cancer type)")) +
  ylab(expression(-log[10]~"(max p-value given cancer type)"))


```
